run.summary: Five acts. Three open blockers, four resolved determinations, one actionable approval package. The pipeline closes ESCALATED rather than fabricating COMPLETE.

statusVocabulary.label: BLOCKED
statusVocabulary.meaning: Missing prerequisite. Nothing to reason over.

statusVocabulary.label: PROVISIONAL
statusVocabulary.meaning: Partially classifiable; ambiguity unresolved. Folded into ESCALATED in impl.

statusVocabulary.label: RESOLVED
statusVocabulary.meaning: Sufficient output reached for this step.

statusVocabulary.label: COMPLETE
statusVocabulary.meaning: Run terminal state; rare on regulated paths.

acts.title: Intake gate
acts.outcome: Questionnaire absent. Pipeline emits BLOCKED. Human intervention clears the gate.

steps.title: R-01 · Questionnaire intake check
steps.summary: No questionnaire submission found. Supervisor emits BLOCKED, all downstream halted, Procurement notified.
steps.rationale: Missing prerequisite evidence — nothing to reason over. The pipeline does not fabricate a determination; it surfaces the gate.

steps.title: R-01 · Human intervention
steps.summary: Procurement requests submission. OptiChain submits the onboarding questionnaire. Gate cleared.
steps.rationale: Gate cleared by human action, not by the model. The supervisor re-enters the pipeline from a valid state.

acts.title: Path classification
acts.outcome: Classification: REGULATED. Fast-track: INELIGIBLE. Downstream review posture is bound.

steps.title: R-02 · Onboarding path classification
steps.summary: EU shift data and SAP S/4HANA data exports trigger REGULATED classification; ERP involvement raises review posture.
steps.rationale: EU personal data alone is sufficient for regulated classification. ERP involvement compounds posture. Middleware-vs-export ambiguity flagged for downstream.

steps.title: R-02 · Fast-track eligibility
steps.summary: Fast-track disqualified: regulated data + ERP involvement + unresolved questionnaire items.
steps.rationale: Classification binds downstream paths. No agent can later override this without citing the matrix.

acts.title: Domain reviews
acts.outcome: Three domains, three states: Legal ESCALATED, IT Security PROVISIONAL, Procurement RESOLVED. No swallowing.

steps.title: R-03 · Legal Agent determination
steps.summary: DPA required and blocks data exchange. NDA status remains provisional pending procurement confirmation.
steps.rationale: dpa_required = true; dpa_blocker = true; nda_status = provisional. Human-owned legal execution required; the model will not sign.

steps.title: R-03 · IT Security Agent determination
steps.summary: Evidence doesn't satisfy Tier 2 (mediated) or Tier 3 (indirect). Integration tier cannot be classified from the questionnaire alone.
steps.rationale: integration_tier = unclassified_pending_review; fast_track_eligible = false. OptiChain must provide architecture diagram + data-flow docs within 10 business days.

steps.title: R-04 · Procurement Agent determination
steps.summary: Approval path: STANDARD. Executive approval not required. Fast-track already denied upstream.
steps.rationale: Matrix rules produce a deterministic path once regulated classification binds.

acts.title: Approval checklist
acts.outcome: ESCALATED. Three blockers preserved with citations; four resolved items preserved with citations.

steps.title: R-05 · Checklist assembly
steps.summary: Bundle composed with authority weighting. Upstream escalations pass through unmutated. No silent swallow.
evidence: Upstream agent outputs (Legal, IT Security, Procurement)
steps.rationale: Null-passthrough discipline: escalated inputs produce escalated outputs. The checklist is the artifact humans act on, not a summary.

blockers.title: GDPR Art. 28 DPA not yet executed

acts.title: Stakeholder guidance
acts.outcome: Pipeline closes ESCALATED. Approval package delivered with cited blockers and per-stakeholder next actions.

steps.title: R-06 · Checkoff & stakeholder guidance
steps.summary: Final determination: ESCALATED. The run ends in the state the evidence warrants — not a fabricated COMPLETE.
steps.rationale: The actionable deliverable is the approval package: cited blockers, assigned owners, estimated unblock window.

stakeholderGuidance.action: Execute GDPR Art. 28 DPA before any data exchange
Request architecture diagram + data-flow docs; assign ERP tier under ISP-001 §12.2
Three blockers open; no implementation until resolved. Est. 10 business days with prompt responses.
